title: Airbnb Listing
description: A vacation rental property listing on the Airbnb platform, including property details, amenities, pricing, availability rules, and photos.

id.description: The unique identifier of the listing.

name.description: The display name of the listing.

description.description: The full description of the property.

property_type.description: The type of property being listed.

room_type.description: The type of room or space being offered.

status.description: The current status of the listing on the platform.

bedrooms.description: The number of bedrooms in the property.

bathrooms.description: The number of bathrooms in the property.

beds.description: The total number of beds in the property.

max_guests.description: The maximum number of guests allowed.

amenities.description: The list of amenity identifiers available at the property.

house_rules.description: The house rules and guidelines for guests.

check_in_time.description: The earliest check-in time in HH:MM format.

check_out_time.description: The latest check-out time in HH:MM format.

photos.description: The photos associated with the listing.

cancellation_policy.description: The cancellation policy applied to the listing.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the listing was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the listing was last updated.

Address.description: The physical address and geolocation of the property.

street.description: The street address of the property.

city.description: The city where the property is located.

state.description: The state or province where the property is located.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the property.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the property.

Pricing.description: The pricing configuration for the listing.

nightly_price.description: The base nightly price in the listing currency.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for pricing.

cleaning_fee.description: The one-time cleaning fee charged per reservation.

weekly_discount.description: The percentage discount for stays of 7 or more nights.

monthly_discount.description: The percentage discount for stays of 28 or more nights.

extra_guest_fee.description: The additional fee per extra guest beyond the base occupancy.

Photo.description: A photo associated with a listing.

id.description: The unique identifier of the photo.

url.description: The URL where the photo is hosted.

sort_order.description: The display position of the photo in the listing gallery.

width.description: The width of the photo in pixels.

height.description: The height of the photo in pixels.
